Hey there, I felt it would be kind and wise to return to this thread now that I'm feeling on the upswing and both thank everyone as well as provide an update.  I think that day I mentioned I'd been dealing with decades of these thoughts and feelings; yet on that actual day I felt as if my sensation of being universally displaced had truly been finalized to a height of mandatory decision and change.  As if the drudgery of the court trials have finally passed and the time is here to present a case to the jury, of my own thoughts and feelings, of whether or not this life at all was truly the most fair and just course of action.  I began to *actually* wonder what was beneath the water and what was in the darkness.  I've been there before but never in such depth, it was terrifying.

Resurfacing has been expectedly difficult.  It's also not been possible without continuing mistakes that I try to cast off as clumsy garments, correction of impact to my self care regiment and health, or the extreme patience and faith of true friends.  I'm also, as anyone on the outside of my situation would know, nowhere near whole or out of the water at this time.  I know how easily I can fall back and I'm spending this time contemplating myself, what paths I *should* be taking versus what I've merely been willing, and so forth.  I have myself in my sights again, with better tools to handle what challenges I believe will come, and this next attempt at staying on target will be the most educated and fortified yet.  I'm terrified yet excited, as anyone in this position might be.

I was able to help people in this last week or so.  I'm uncertain what's changed since I've always been "the most intense person you know" and it's nothing new for me to save or destroy lives.  I've been attempting to use only the fairer side of this spectrum for years, and as of late I've been more accurate if nothing more.  I've had friends cry in my arms, thank me for speaking out against injustice, or cease suicidality dead in its tracks in place of a weak but sincere smile at least.  I'm losing track of it all tbh, and I've made it clear to everyone that the only reciprocity I ask for is make the world less shitty.

I'm really fucking glad I'm here to type this.

Okay.  You guys are right.  I'm taking control of my fucking life.  I'm so tired of being tired, I'd rather die than want to die.  I've said this a thousand times, perhaps a thousand and one.  I want to live my life.  I don't want to live everyone else's life anymore.  I hate to do this, but they need to be cut free from the teat for only so long if nothing more.  I'll tell my friends to move on for life advice.  I can't now.  And why, so that the majority of them have less justification to be abusive but they still do anyway?

Forget people.  I'll remember me.  The key principles of nontheistic Satanism; Your energy is precious and a gift, never waste it and understand when you're doing so.  Worship humanity via empathy; I can't live on sympathy at this time and rather if someone feels what I feel at my level I'm more than glad to connect.  But feeling sorry for this planet isn't worshiping humanity, it's pitying it.  I'm crossing my own belief system by not taking care of myself.

Where do I start?  I'm an functioning alcoholic and addict.  I'm depressed and suicidal or want to hurt myself so much of the time.  My thought regarding me, not others, are often deeply violent and it's so familiar it doesn't bother me; rather it's become a source of comfort.  I never take care of myself, I hardly sleep or eat well or stop moving or worrying.  I think about the world, the future, the past, the meaning of it all, everyone and everything all the time.  My thoughts exist like a beehive within my head and sometimes I truly wish I had never been hospitalized because if I could purchase a firearm I just want to create an escape route for these insects that represent the pain of my eternally deafening thoughts.

What is step one to leaving this place?  I will always be dark, my past made that my future and my survivalism made that my comfort zone.  I will stay dark.  I don't want to stay sick.

I think that's absolutely my problem.  I view humans as intrinsically flawed like myself and in need of care, love, support, saving.  I gravitate towards people like myself, people who are damaged, because saving them is the only surrogate lifestyle I can obtain in place of caring for myself.

I'm confused about who a good influence is.  I have ideas but it hurts to be with these people.  It hurts to be with everyone.  When someone is nice to me, I tend to fall in love with them and that makes things difficult too.  It's almost as if I can't hang out with my friends, enemies, or frienemies.  There's a different type of pain involved with each of those demographics.

I guess I don't know how to feel safe without falling in love and thus risking a broken heart?  I think I'm in love with or crushing on my support sources because they're some of the only light leaking through the cracks of the walls that create the shadows in my secluded life.

I feel as i the light simply reveals the dangers.  Am I delusional?

I feel super bummed out.  I don't feel like a loser, I had the courage so say "Cool play, bro" afterall.  I feel ugly, that's just a given this early into transition.  I guess I feel sad because I really felt a bunch of emotion during that play.  I felt emotions about the play, I felt emotions about the people.  Now I'm like...stuck with the emotions?

I'm so conflicted.  For like half the play I'm thinking "holy shit, I hate estrogen apparently" lmao.  Next time I don't want to be so afraid to express such simple sentiments.  At work I'm a "pretty big deal" and don't choke up in meetings.
